newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 29.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Israel ends role of the European Union's Middle East envoy.
- Yemeni police arrest suspects in Aden explosions.
- Syria and the World Bank reach a solution over Damascus' debt problem.
- An Egyptian-Yemeni committee discusses launching a free trade zone.
- Palestinian finance minister urges the setting up of a $600-$800 million development fund.
- King Fahd says his country backs Arab rights in Palestine, Lebanon and the Golan Heights.
- Egyptian economy minister says no intention to cancel Islamic banks.
- Saudi's National Commercial Bank lifts net profit in the first six months of 1997 to 590.3 million riyals.
- Jordan ends talks with the World Bank over a $32 million loan to finance tourism projects.
